field.label: Sequence
field.help: Policies are evaluated in ascending order; the first match wins.

field.label: Action
field.help: Block adds the destination to a pf table and drops later connections. Allow stops evaluation (an exemption). Monitor only records.

field.label: Interfaces / VLANs
field.help: Limit the policy to clients behind these interfaces (use VLAN interfaces for per-VLAN policies). Empty means all.

field.label: Source networks
field.help: Optional extra client addresses or networks (e.g. 10.77.0.0/24).

field.label: Users
field.help: Named users defined on the Users page; matched by their IP addresses.

field.label: Applications
field.help: Match these applications (nDPI names such as YouTube, Facebook).

field.label: Application categories
field.help: Match these nDPI categories (e.g. SocialNetwork, Game, VPN).

field.label: Host names
field.help: Match TLS server names / HTTP hosts and their subdomains (e.g. example.com).

field.label: Start time
field.help: HH:MM. Equal start and end time means all day. A window that ends before it starts runs overnight.

field.label: DNS block categories
field.help: For block policies: also block these DNS categories for the policy's source networks.

field.label: DNS block domains
field.help: For block policies: also block these domains for the policy's source networks.
